description: Work with your Pepper Cloud CRM data directly in chat. Query and update records across modules like contacts and opportunities, log notes and tasks against them, check ticket status and details, and review quotations. Pull conversation summaries and sentiment insights, all grounded in your actual Pepper Cloud data. Learn more: https://blog.peppercloud.com/pepper-cloud-assistai-for-chatgpt/
